claimChanges.claimText: DeepSeek-R1 (671B) is listed for South China University of Technology in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: self hosted system.

The SCUT undergraduate AI-enabled teaching pilot notice says the university would support pilot-course teams with AI technical guidance, teacher training and exchange activities, funding, production fees paid by the university, and priority teaching-assistant allocation during pilot delivery.

SCUT's 2025 AI-enabled undergraduate teaching pilot call identified course agents, knowledge graphs, 24-hour intelligent learning companions, AI teaching assistants, intelligent grading, resource search, classroom assistants, preparation support, teaching management, digital humans, and internationalization as possible construction scenarios.
SCUT Graduate School announced a trial AI general and practice online course for all 2025 graduate students, including part-time graduate students and international students.

SCUT's student academic misconduct measures list plagiarism, copying, misappropriation of academic results, tampering with research results, and falsifying data or materials as examples of academic misconduct.
South China University of Technology's student academic misconduct handling measures apply to undergraduate and graduate students receiving ordinary higher education at the university.
